findings.title: Same-amount matching can attach an unrelated provider refund to a local attempt
findings.detail: FIXED. refundFor matches stored provider identity, originating attempt or platform refund reference; there is no amount fallback. Unknown refunds open provider-specific cases at line 1381, and conflicting identities are handled at line 1316. apps/api/test/b09-review.test.ts:118 checks the webhook/settlement interleaving, distinct identities and incident amounts; packages/application/test/commerce-planners.test.ts:429 checks a conflicting dispatch response. These files are unchanged from 4b33e264. Both regressions pass at verify.log:716 and :287.
findings.reproduction: Read assertions at apps/api/test/b09-review.test.ts:137, :143 and :149: the separate 1000-cent refund leaves the local refund SUBMITTING, opens its own incident, and settlement completes the local refund with its own provider ID.

findings.title: A reversal observed before its completed refund double-counts returned money
findings.detail: FIXED. Completion reads capture status under FOR SHARE at line 345. A reversed capture produces zero returned components and zero movable balance at lines 393–400. packages/domain/src/commerce/ledger.ts:156 defines the rule, and packages/application/src/commerce/core/postings.ts:122 consumes the returned components. apps/api/test/b09-review.test.ts:226 covers all three observation orders, with and without a retained fee. Implementation and regression files are unchanged from 4b33e264; verify.log:717 records the pass.
findings.reproduction: Read apps/api/test/b09-review.test.ts:233 and :239: each scenario has exact final ledger balances, and reversal plus refund returns exactly 97125 service cents. Line 241 checks independence from event delivery order.

findings.title: An earlier refund prevents the watchdog from resolving a later no-effect attempt
findings.detail: FIXED. The absence check compares each in-flight refund's provider identity or platform reference, rather than treating any refund of the capture as its trace. Line 839 invokes provedNoEffect only after authoritative deadline-qualified absence; the qualification is at lines 774–776. apps/api/test/b09-review.test.ts:286 exercises an earlier completed refund alongside timed-out and never-sent attempts. These files are unchanged from 4b33e264; verify.log:719 records the pass.
findings.reproduction: Read apps/api/test/b09-review.test.ts:313–322: repeated watchdog calls leave both later refunds APPROVED, their attempts FAILED_NO_EFFECT, the earlier refund COMPLETED, and provider refund effects unchanged.

findings.title: Provider fees learned with or after reversal are silently discarded
findings.detail: FIXED. Fee learning applies to COMPLETED and REVERSED captures. The event's movable balance accounts for reversal at line 1138; packages/persistence/src/repositories/commerce-captures.ts:372 applies the same rule. apps/api/test/b09-review.test.ts:248 covers fees learned with reversal, after reversal and through a reversal webhook, including duplicate suppression. These files are unchanged from 4b33e264; verify.log:718 records the pass.
findings.reproduction: Read apps/api/test/b09-review.test.ts:258–279: the 5275-cent fee is persisted and emitted once, with zero movable balance after reversal; the ledger retains exactly 5275 cents of processor expense and the corresponding available-balance debit.
